items.caption: In this seal-script-style form, 菜 combines 艸, associated with plants, and 采 as its phonetic element, as described in the Shuowen account.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style rendering of 菜, with branching strokes at the top and long descending strokes below.
items.selection_reason: This legible form illustrates the graph discussed in the entry and its stated 艸-plus-采 analysis. It is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact.

limitations.text: The image is a modern vector redraw in Shuowen seal-script style; it does not establish the date or appearance of a specific ancient specimen. The earliest secure attestation of the full graph remains unclear, and no securely identified oracle-bone form of 菜 is established here.
